YAML
version: '3.9'

services:
  wordpress:
    image: wordpress:6.9-php8.2-apache
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DEBUG: '1'
      WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA: |
        define('WP_DEBUG_LOG', true);
        define('SCRIPT_DEBUG', true);
    volumes:
      - ./:/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/code-block-pro
    ports:
      - "8080:80"

x-anchors: &defaults
  restart: unless-stopped
